name: Gated delta fixed-warp geometry admission correction
modifications: Original dispatcher guard: use the existing mathematically exact ops recurrence when key width is below 32 or not divisible by 32.
The generic Metal kernel uses Dk/32 registers per lane; smaller widths fail compilation and partial strips omit key elements. Complete strips retain the existing generic and packed admission.
